verdict.rationale: The story applies: an open-source on-device inference project can publish release history and patch cadence. However, the evidence pack has no changelog, release notes, security advisories or patch-timing data. The closest items are generation-versioning notes (Needle 2 vs Needle 3) and community bug reports, and neither shows how quickly fixes ship.

support.subject: As a developer, I know how quickly the project ships patches for critical bugs and security vulnerabilities based on its public release history
